frozen_candidate_root_contribution: dun is a relational positioner: it fixes a reference point R (always the superior/primary term, explicit or 'dhalika') and locates the marked item on the NOT-R side of R -- short of R, on the near side of R, or to the exclusion of R. dun itself carries none of 'god', 'worship', 'false', 'hostility', or 'negation'; those come from the matrix verbs/nouns (ya'budun, yad'un, ittakhadhu, awliya', alihah) and from surrounding ma/la. Context selects the pole: a scale -> 'lesser than / short of'; space/time -> 'on the near side of / before'; a choice-set -> 'other than / instead of / to the exclusion of'.

Context selects the pole: a scale -> 'lesser than / short of'; space/time -> 'on the near side of / before'; a choice-set -> 'other than / instead of / to the exclusion of'.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root shows up in the Quran only as the little relational word dun (accusative duna, 9x; genitive after min, min duni, 135x) -- never as a verb, participle, or verbal noun. Its one job is to place something relative to a benchmark R and say it does not reach, does not include, or is set apart from R. On a scale that reads 'less than' (the lesser punishment short of the greater, 32:21; speech below loudness, 7:205); in space it reads 'on the near side of' (a cover this side of the sun, 18:90; a people short of the two barriers, 18:93); in a choice it reads 'instead of / to the exclusion of' (men instead of women, 27:55; allies to the exclusion of the believers, 3:28). The famous 'besides Allah' phrase is just this last pole with R = God; the idolatry lives in the verbs, not in dun.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: dun does NOT mean worship/allegiance/deity/falsehood (supplied by 'abada, da'a, ittakhadha, awliya', alihah, al-batil at 22:62, 31:30); does NOT assert non-existence of R or of the marked object (the 'gods duna Allah' exist and are actively worshipped, 10:18, 16:20; the second Gardens exist, 55:62); does NOT mean literal 'beneath' (taht) -- 18:93 is 'short of reaching', not 'under'; does NOT mark the greater/superior member (never *duna al-adna*; always al-adna duna al-akbar, 32:21); is NOT theologically specialized (R can be women, people, the believers, one's own community, or a mixed human set, 27:55/2:94/3:28/9:16); carries NO negation itself (the 'no protector besides God' force comes from ma/la ... min, 2:107); and is NOT a plain synonym of ghayr -- it adds a shortfall/near-side vector ghayr lacks (7:205, 32:21).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 55:62:2:1 wa-min duni-hima jannatani: the second pair of Gardens is ADDED alongside the first pair, not put in its place and not ranked below it, so dun here resists both the exclusion pole ('instead of') and the scalar refinement ('lesser than'); only the bare positional relation ('on the other side of the reference pair') survives.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That dun is a pure exclusion/alterity marker (ghayr-like 'other-than'/'instead-of'), with 'lesser/below' being merely contextual. This elegantly covers the ~117 theological occurrences, the human-substitution class (27:55, 3:28), and the bare-accusative 37:86. It is rejected as the nucleus because it cannot carry the scalar bloc: 32:21 (al-adna duna al-akbar is explicit ranking work, not substitution), 7:205 (duna l-jahr = a lower degree of loudness), and 72:11/7:168 (a class ranked below the righteous). Pure 'otherness' leaves the shortfall residue unexplained, whereas the near-side/short-of positioner subsumes both faces. A secondary competitor -- a homonymy split partitioning genitive 'min duni'=exclusion from accusative 'duna'=scalar -- is rejected because case does not partition meaning: 37:86 (accusative) does exclusion and 55:62/18:90/18:93/19:17 (genitive) do scalar/spatial.

This elegantly covers the ~117 theological occurrences, the human-substitution class (27:55, 3:28), and the bare-accusative 37:86. It is rejected as the nucleus because it cannot carry the scalar bloc: 32:21 (al-adna duna al-akbar is explicit ranking work, not substitution), 7:205 (duna l-jahr = a lower degree of loudness), and 72:11/7:168 (a class ranked below the righteous). Pure 'otherness' leaves the shortfall residue unexplained, whereas the near-side/short-of positioner subsumes both faces. A secondary competitor -- a homonymy split partitioning genitive 'min duni'=exclusion from accusative 'duna'=scalar -- is rejected because case does not partition meaning: 37:86 (accusative) does exclusion and 55:62/18:90/18:93/19:17 (genitive) do scalar/spatial.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converged on one thin positional relator covering all 144 occurrences, and on MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE. The positional invariant is broad, distinctive, Quran-internal, and survives adversarial probing (the spatial cases 18:90/18:93 anchor it literally; the scalar cases 32:21/7:205 and the substitution cases 27:55/3:28 show the two derived poles; 37:86 bridges the bare accusative to the dominant genitive idiom). But two contract caps hold. (1) A resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class dominates: ~117/144 are the single frozen construction '[verb] ... min duni llah', whose force is carried jointly by the matrix verb and tawhid context, not by dun alone; high frequency here is idiom, not proof of a rich root meaning, and within it dun's distinctive shortfall vector is bleached to bare exclusion. (2) The scalar class and the exclusion class are joined only by an abstraction ('stops before / does not include R'); the Quran never makes the spatial->scalar pivot explicit on one axis, so their unity is reconstructed, not demonstrated, and pushed further the abstraction risks fitting everything. Both conditions cap strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. STRONG is not earned; UNRESOLVED is too pessimistic given the clean positional through-line and the 37:86 bridge.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Exclusion pole with R = God / al-Rahman (or a divine referent, incl. mixed sets containing God): what is worshipped/invoked/taken-as-ally/relied-upon 'to the exclusion of / instead of / apart from' the true referent. dun supplies only the 'other-than-R' relation; the theology is in the matrix verbs and nouns.
clusters.classification_rationale: The dominant lexicalized frame '[verb/noun] ... min duni llah / min duni-hi / min duni r-rahman', plus the polemical negative frame 'ma lakum min duni llahi min waliyy'. Grammatically the genitive min-duni realization; semantically Class X with R=God. Includes 21:43 (alihatun tamna'uhum min duni-na = gods acting apart from Us, not against Us) and 37:86 (same idiom in the bare accusative), which shows the frame is compositional on dun.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: R here is the superior benchmark (God) and the marked items are positioned outside/short of legitimate standing relative to Him; consistent with the positional nucleus. This is the resistant lexicalized sub-class that caps overall strength: its shortfall vector is bleached toward bare exclusion, and its high frequency is idiom, not independent proof of a rich root meaning. 37:86:3:1 alihatan duna llah: the theological 'besides Allah' idiom realized in the BARE ACCUSATIVE duna with no min, proving the ~117-strong genitive frame 'min duni llah' is compositional on dun and not a frozen 'min duni' lexeme.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Exclusion/substitution pole with R = a human or human set: 'other than / instead of / to the exclusion of R' -- men instead of women, allies to the exclusion of the believers, reserved apart from the people, confidants other than your own.
clusters.classification_rationale: Same 'min duni + [human R]' frame as the theological class but with non-divine referents (al-nisa', al-mu'minin, al-nas, dunikum, dunihim, and the mixed set God+Messenger+believers at 9:16). Decisive that dun is NOT theologically specialized and that the frame stays live and compositional.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 27:55/7:81 (men in place of women) admit no scalar 'lesser' reading -- pure substitution; 3:28/4:139/4:144 (allies to the exclusion of the believers) and 9:16 (R includes humans) show R need not be divine. These minority tokens carry the true live semantic range that the frequent idiom only instantiates.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Spatial pole: 'on the near/hither side of R / interposed between subject and R / set apart from R' -- the literal anchor of the relation.
clusters.classification_rationale: Concrete separation/barrier readings: 18:90 (no cover on the near side of the sun), 18:93 (a people this side of the two barriers), 19:17 (a screen setting her apart from them), 28:23 (two women at a remove from the crowd).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: These unbleached concrete cases show dun's bare contribution most transparently and provide the physical bridge from which the scalar and exclusion poles are read off; fully consistent with the positional nucleus.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Scalar/degree pole: 'short of / lesser than / below R' on a scale -- and, at the edges, additive/temporal 'beyond / prior to R'. R is the higher benchmark and the marked term does not reach it.
clusters.classification_rationale: Bare-accusative 'duna dhalika/duna l-jahr/al-adna duna l-akbar' (32:21, 7:205, 72:11, 7:168, 52:47, 21:82, 4:48, 4:116) and the same scalar sense in the genitive frame (23:63, 48:27, 55:62). The scalar sense appears in BOTH case-forms, confirming N/LOC is case-syntactic, not semantic.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 32:21 and 7:205 are the clearest cases that no exclusion gloss can carry -- they anchor the scalar pole and refute the pure-exclusion competitor. 32:21:5:1 al-'adhabi l-adna duna l-'adhabi l-akbar: the lesser punishment 'short of' the greater is an explicit magnitude ranking (both are threatened, neither replaces the other), which a pure 'other-than' gloss would flatten; dun marks the inferior member of a scale. 7:205:7:2 wa-duna l-jahri mina l-qawl: remembrance placed 'below loudness' is a pure degree-below-a-threshold with no rival object and no deity, forcing the nucleus down to a thin positional 'short-of-R' schema and refuting any account that reads dun as inherently exclusion/'instead-of'. Three members (55:62, 48:27, 23:63) fit the broad positional invariant but resist the scalar refinement itself and are overridden to RESISTANT.

reconciliation.rationale: The relational nucleus holds, but whether the second pair of Gardens is 'lesser' or merely 'additional' is Quran-internally undecidable, so the case resists the scalar refinement and is recorded as a resistant seam rather than forced into 'lesser-than'.

It reads temporal-sequential ('prior to that') and does not exclude the promised entry nor rank primarily by degree; it fits only the thin positional core and resists both dominant poles, so it is marked resistant.
'lesser' vs 'other/different' cannot be decided from Quran-internal evidence; the refinement is undemonstrable here, so it is preserved as a resistant seam.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial probing SUPPORTED the thin positional nucleus and its distinctiveness from ghayr/taht/ma'a, but three scalar-frame occurrences resist the scalar refinement while still fitting the broad relation; because these residual resisters remain, a clean PASSED (empty failing set) is not claimable, so the status is NOT_RUN with the resisters recorded rather than overstating a pass.

occurrence_dispositions.note: The dominant lexicalized frame '[verb/noun] ... min duni llah / min duni-hi / min duni r-rahman', plus the polemical negative frame 'ma lakum min duni llahi min waliyy'. Grammatically the genitive min-duni realization; semantically Class X with R=God. Includes 21:43 (alihatun tamna'uhum min duni-na = gods acting apart from Us, not against Us) and 37:86 (same idiom in the bare accusative), which shows the frame is compositional on dun.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Exclusion pole with R = God / al-Rahman (or a divine referent, incl. mixed sets containing God): what is worshipped/invoked/taken-as-ally/relied-upon 'to the exclusion of / instead of / apart from' the true referent. dun supplies only the 'other-than-R' relation; the theology is in the matrix verbs and nouns.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: R here is the superior benchmark (God) and the marked items are positioned outside/short of legitimate standing relative to Him; consistent with the positional nucleus. This is the resistant lexicalized sub-class that caps overall strength: its shortfall vector is bleached toward bare exclusion, and its high frequency is idiom, not independent proof of a rich root meaning. 37:86:3:1 alihatan duna llah: the theological 'besides Allah' idiom realized in the BARE ACCUSATIVE duna with no min, proving the ~117-strong genitive frame 'min duni llah' is compositional on dun and not a frozen 'min duni' lexeme.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Read as 'deeds short-of that' within the scalar class.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: 'lesser' vs 'other/different' cannot be decided from Quran-internal evidence; the refinement is undemonstrable here, so it is preserved as a resistant seam.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Read as 'short of / on the near side of that' within the scalar/positional class.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: It reads temporal-sequential ('prior to that') and does not exclude the promised entry nor rank primarily by degree; it fits only the thin positional core and resists both dominant poles, so it is marked resistant.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Placed in the scalar/positional class as 'two Gardens besides/beyond those two'.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The relational nucleus holds, but whether the second pair of Gardens is 'lesser' or merely 'additional' is Quran-internally undecidable, so the case resists the scalar refinement and is recorded as a resistant seam rather than forced into 'lesser-than'.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, C) each read all 144 occurrences and all 9 LOC cases in full and converged on the same nucleus, the same competitor rejection, and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grade with overlapping resistant occurrences (55:62 flagged by B and C; 48:27 by A; 23:63 by A and B).
candidate_root_contribution: dun is a relational positioner: it fixes a reference point R (always the superior/primary term, explicit or 'dhalika') and locates the marked item on the NOT-R side of R -- short of R, on the near side of R, or to the exclusion of R. dun itself carries none of 'god', 'worship', 'false', 'hostility', or 'negation'; those come from the matrix verbs/nouns (ya'budun, yad'un, ittakhadhu, awliya', alihah) and from surrounding ma/la. Context selects the pole: a scale -> 'lesser than / short of'; space/time -> 'on the near side of / before'; a choice-set -> 'other than / instead of / to the exclusion of'.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 144 tokens: genitive min-duni (135, tag N) and bare accusative duna (9, tag LOC); qac_verb_form is null in every entry -- no finite verb, participle, or masdar anywhere. The two forms are one lexeme in two case roles (37:86 accusative does exclusion; 55:62 genitive does scalar/spatial).
layer_attribution.derivation: No derivational family exists: the root surfaces solely as the grammaticalized relator dun. There is no verb->noun->participle spread to attribute meaning to, which is itself a structural constraint on any 'rich root' claim.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One relational positioner realized as a quasi-preposition; its dominant instantiation is the lexicalized frame 'min duni llah' (~117/144), a partly-frozen theological collocation that is nonetheless compositional on dun (shown by 37:86 and by live non-divine/spatial referents).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The theology (worship, false gods, allegiance, non-existence of a protector) is contributed by the matrix verbs/nouns ('abada, da'a, ittakhadha, awliya', alihah, waliyy) and by ma/la...min, NOT by dun; dun only positions the item on the not-R side of R. This contextual/narrative content must not be read back into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary CONSISTENT readings for 55:62, 48:27, 23:63 were downgraded to RESISTANT because the scalar refinement is Quran-internally undecidable there; boundary cases 7:205 and 32:21 were retained as CONSISTENT and used to refute the pure-exclusion competitor.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The scalar pole and the exclusion pole are unified only by an abstraction; the spatial->scalar pivot is never made explicit on one axis, and 55:62/48:27/23:63 remain resistant to the scalar refinement. This residual resistance, plus the dominant bleached lexicalized bloc, is what caps the result at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and blocks STRONG.

hard_cases.reason: Added, not substituted or ranked below; resists both the exclusion pole and the scalar refinement.

evidence_basis.statement: 55:62:2:1 wa-min duni-hima jannatani: the second pair of Gardens is ADDED alongside the first pair, not put in its place and not ranked below it, so dun here resists both the exclusion pole ('instead of') and the scalar refinement ('lesser than'); only the bare positional relation ('on the other side of the reference pair') survives.

hard_cases.reason: Temporal-sequential 'prior to / on the near side of that'; resists both dominant poles.

evidence_basis.statement: 48:27:25:1 min duni dhalika fathan qariban: a near victory appointed 'short of / on the near side of' the promised entry, reading as temporal-sequential 'prior to that'; it resists clean exclusion (the near victory does not replace the entry) and clean scalar degree, fitting only the broad positional invariant extended into time.

hard_cases.reason: Undecidable 'lesser' vs 'different'; scalar refinement not demonstrable.

evidence_basis.statement: 23:63:10:1 a'malun min duni dhalika: deeds 'short of / other than that' are undecidable Quran-internally between 'lesser in rank' and merely 'different from', so the scalar refinement of the nucleus is not demonstrable here.

hard_cases.reason: Pure degree-below-a-threshold with no rival object or deity; forces the nucleus to a thin positional schema and refutes the pure-exclusion competitor.

evidence_basis.statement: 7:205:7:2 wa-duna l-jahri mina l-qawl: remembrance placed 'below loudness' is a pure degree-below-a-threshold with no rival object and no deity, forcing the nucleus down to a thin positional 'short-of-R' schema and refuting any account that reads dun as inherently exclusion/'instead-of'.

hard_cases.reason: Explicit magnitude ranking (both punishments threatened, neither replaces the other); a pure 'other-than' gloss would flatten it.

evidence_basis.statement: 32:21:5:1 al-'adhabi l-adna duna l-'adhabi l-akbar: the lesser punishment 'short of' the greater is an explicit magnitude ranking (both are threatened, neither replaces the other), which a pure 'other-than' gloss would flatten; dun marks the inferior member of a scale.

hard_cases.reason: The theological 'besides Allah' idiom realized in the bare accusative with no min, proving the dominant genitive frame is compositional on dun, not a frozen 'min duni' lexeme.

evidence_basis.statement: 37:86:3:1 alihatan duna llah: the theological 'besides Allah' idiom realized in the BARE ACCUSATIVE duna with no min, proving the ~117-strong genitive frame 'min duni llah' is compositional on dun and not a frozen 'min duni' lexeme.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The account is PREFERRED with a live resistant seam: three occurrences (55:62, 48:27, 23:63) fit the broad positional relation but resist its scalar refinement and are marked RESISTANT and listed as counterevidence; two boundary cases (7:205, 32:21) refute the pure-exclusion competitor and pin the nucleus thin; and 37:86 is a structural bridge from the bare accusative to the dominant genitive idiom. Each hard case is evidence-derived from an actual occurrence reading rather than asserted.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: An occurrence in which dun contributes theological or evaluative content on its own -- i.e. means 'worship', 'false deity', 'hostility-against', or 'lowliness' independently of the matrix verb/noun and context -- OR a case where the marked term is the SUPERIOR member of the relation (dun applied to the greater benchmark, e.g. *al-akbar duna al-adna).
rejection_condition.search_location: The 117-strong 'min duni llah' theological bloc for smuggled theology, and every scalar member (32:21, 7:205, 72:11, 7:168, 52:47, 21:82, 4:48, 4:116, 23:63, 48:27, 55:62) for directionality of the ranking.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Strip the matrix verb/noun and the ma/la negation from each occurrence and test whether dun alone still yields the claimed force; and check every scalar case for whether dun ever marks the higher-ranked term rather than the lower.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Attribute 'abada/da'a/ittakhadha, awliya'/alihah/al-batil, and ma...min to their own layers so their meaning is not credited to dun; treat the N/LOC split as case, not sense (verified by 37:86 vs 55:62), so a case-based reading is not mistaken for a semantic one.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If dun independently carries theology/evaluation, or ever marks the superior member, the thin positional nucleus is falsified and the result would collapse to a lexicalized-theological class (LOCAL) or to UNRESOLVED multi-class.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal reading resolves whether 55:62 'wa-min duni-hima jannatani' ranks the second pair of Gardens BELOW the first (scalar) or merely ADDS them (additive), the scalar refinement could be extended or the resistant seam closed.

If any occurrence is found where dun marks the SUPERIOR member of the relation (e.g. the greater punishment stated as duna the lesser), or where dun alone -- stripped of 'abada/da'a/ittakhadha and awliya'/alihah -- carries worship/hostility/falsehood, the thin positional nucleus must be reopened.

If a verse transparently pivots the SAME dun-token from a spatial 'near-side' reading to a scalar 'lesser-than' reading on one axis, the currently reconstructed spatial->scalar bridge would become demonstrated and could lift the grade above MODERATE.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: Adversarial probing SUPPORTED the thin positional nucleus and its distinctiveness from ghayr/taht/ma'a, but three scalar-frame occurrences resist the scalar refinement while still fitting the broad relation; because these residual resisters remain, a clean PASSED (empty failing set) is not claimable, so the status is NOT_RUN with the resisters recorded rather than overstating a pass.
